SCOPE OF WORK - **MECHANICAL PERMIT - 20260624002**  INTERIOR SELECTIVE DEMOLITION & MOLD / FUNGAL REMEDIATION Kitchen and Laundry Room – Complete Removal for Habitability Restoration  Project Description  This project consists of storm-related selective interior demolition and mold/fungal remediation within the Kitchen and Laundry Room areas only, required to restore the structure to a safe, sanitary, and habitable condition following water intrusion associated with a declared storm event. No structural alterations to the primary load-bearing system are included.  All work will be performed in accordance with EPA guidelines, OSHA standards, Florida Department of Health mold remediation guidance, and Volusia County requirements under the Owner-Builder exemption, where applicable.  A. SITE PREPARATION & CONTAINMENT  Install full containment using 6-mil polyethylene sheeting, tape, and zipper access doors to isolate Kitchen and Laundry areas.  Seal HVAC registers, returns, and openings to prevent cross-contamination.  Establish and maintain negative air pressure using HEPA air scrubbers.  Deploy LGR dehumidifiers to control moisture throughout the project.  Maintain jobsite documentation including photos and moisture readings.  B. SELECTIVE DEMOLITION (COMPLETE REMOVAL – KITCHEN & LAUNDRY)  Remove and dispose of all water- and mold-impacted drywall, ceiling materials, insulation, trim, baseboards, and non-salvageable cabinetry within affected areas.  Remove deteriorated or contaminated finishes down to exposed framing.  Bag, seal, and dispose of debris in accordance with EPA and local disposal regulations.  C. MOLD / FUNGAL REMEDIATION  Perform HEPA vacuuming of all exposed framing, sheathing, and subfloor surfaces.  Conduct detergent cleaning followed by application of EPA-registered antimicrobial agents (e.g., ShockWave, Benefect Decon 30, or equivalent).  Wire-brush and spot-clean visibly affected wood framing as required.  Maintain negative pressure and dehumidification during cleaning and drying phases.  D. DRYING, CLEANING & VERIFICATION  Continue dehumidification until acceptable moisture levels are achieved.  Perform final HEPA vacuum pass and damp wipe of all remediated surfaces.  Conduct visual inspection and moisture verification to confirm areas are clean and dry.  Remove containment barriers upon completion and prepare areas for future reconstruction.  E. EXCLUSIONS / CLARIFICATIONS  No reconstruction (drywall, insulation, cabinetry, flooring, or finishes) is included.  No asbestos or lead abatement is included.  No electrical or plumbing modifications beyond safe disconnection and protection.  Structural repairs, if discovered, will be addressed under a separate permit if required.  Owner to pull permit under Florida Owner-Builder exemption, if applicable.  PROJECT DURATION  Estimated duration: 5–7 working days, subject to drying conditions.   PURPOSE OF PERMIT  This permit application is submitted to allow expedited approval for interior demolition and mold remediation work necessary to restore minimum habitability following storm-related water intrusion.
